claims.content: To allow the System Administrator to define and allocate roles and permissions (such as Edit, Delete, View, Print) to User Groups within the system.

goal.raw_text: To allow the System Administrator to define and allocate roles and permissions (such as Edit, Delete, View, Print) to User Groups within the system.

claims.content: System Administrator
The system's security settings must be configured to be based on User Groups.
The System Administrator must have the authority to create User Groups, as this capability is restricted to them.
The system must require mandatory entry of Group Code and Group Name when defining a User Group.
The system must require mandatory definition of transaction permissions (such as New, Edit, Delete, View, Print) as Allowed or Not Allowed during User Group creation.
The System Administrator initiates the creation of a new User Group or the modification of an existing User Group's permissions.

trigger.raw_text: The System Administrator initiates the creation of a new User Group or the modification of an existing User Group's permissions.

claims.content: The System Administrator enters the Group Code and Group Name for the new User Group.
The System Administrator defines transaction permissions by specifying the Screen Name and setting the 'New' permission to Allowed or Not Allowed.
The System Administrator sets the remaining transaction permissions (Edit, Delete, View, Print) to either Allowed or Not Allowed.
The system validates that all entered information (Group Code, Group Name, and all transaction permissions) is provided, as these fields are mandatory.
If the System Administrator attempts to create a User Group with a name that already exists, the system should not allow the creation.
If the System Administrator attempts to create a User Group or Individual User with an existing name, the system must not allow the creation.
If the System Administrator fails to provide mandatory entries (such as Group Name, User Name, Password, Verify Password), the system must not save the user information.
If the Password and Verify Password values entered by the System Administrator do not match, the system must not save the user information.
The new or modified User Group is successfully created or updated in the system with the specified Group Code, Group Name, and transaction permissions.
The system ensures that no duplicate User Group names exist, as it does not allow the creation of a User Group with an existing name.
